title: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme - Revised Framework
description: <cite index="20-3,20-4">The Reserve Bank of India's revised Integrated Ombudsman Scheme has come into effect, introducing updated rules for resolving customer complaints against banks, select NBFCs, prepaid payment instrument issuers and credit information companies. The new framework replaces the 2021 scheme and aims to provide a faster, free and customer-friendly mechanism for addressing service-related complaints.</cite>
